newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish April new car registrations up 58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swedish April new car registrations up 58 pct.

text.p: Swedish new car registrations rose 58 percent in April to 26,352 vehicles from April 1996, Sweden's official statistics bureau Statistics Sweden said on Monday.
Truck registrations rose 29.8 percent to 2,311 in April, the office said.

Industry group AB Bilstatistik, which unlike Statistics Sweden only count registrations of new cars, said on May 2 that car registrations rose 48 percent to 23,328 vehicles in April from the same month a year earlier.
